reviews.comment:
El ACA es fantástico y su gente, habitantes con seriedad y experiencia. Te resuelven cualquier problema con el auto en la calle. Nunca te dejan «a pata». Pero ayer domingo por la tarde, había un solo muchacho por surtidor. Debe ser tema de YPF. Hubo mucha espera y la gente se quejaba. Y además con el 5% de descuento se sabe que ese día hay más autos que cargan. (Podrían hacer el descuento viernes, sábado y domingo, de forma tal de no acumular consumo un solo día).

(Translated by Google)
The ACA (Automobile Club of Argentina) is fantastic, and its people are serious and experienced. They'll solve any problem you have with your car on the street. They never leave you stranded. But yesterday afternoon, Sunday, there was only one attendant per pump. It must be a YPF issue. There were long waits, and people were complaining. And with the 5% discount, it's known that more cars fill up that day. (They could offer the discount Friday, Saturday, and Sunday, so as not to accumulate consumption on a single day.)
